ecosystems.note: Cross-ecosystem repositories (this profile, ELECTRO-HOBBY-3D-UPDATER): no updater of their own; ELECTRO-HOBBY-3D-UPDATER dispatches to the three ecosystem updaters.

_about: ecosystem/manifest_file/dashboard_exclude are the HYDRA-UMC discovery settings read by hydra_umc_updater.parse_catalog; 'ecosystems' lists every ecosystem the dashboard reports and is checked against scripts/generate_dashboard.py by scripts/catalog_check.py.
